sentences: The VGPR file is a Function-scope uint array, so `v_movrels_b32`/`v_movreld_b32`/`v_movrelsd_b32` become dynamic array accesses at `reg + M0` (the whole of M0, as the RDNA2 ISA's opcode descriptions say).

`v_movrelsd_2_b32` (VOP1 opcode 72) offsets each side by its own field: VGPR[D + M0[25:16]] = VGPR[S0 + M0[9:0]], other M0 bits ignored (RDNA2 ISA §12.8 opcode description and the RDNA3 ISA; the RDNA2 §6.6 summary table prints M0[7:0] for the source).
Not modelled: the hardware's range check against the wave's VGPR allocation (an out-of-range source reads VGPR0, an out-of-range write is dropped).

CPU-checked by `tests/semantic/test_alu_movrelsd_2.py` (including set ignored M0 bits); GPU-checked with `runtime/test/shaders/cs_movrelsd_2.asm` (the ISA's own example, v25 ← v17 with M0 = (20 << 16) \ | 10) on NVIDIA RTX 4050 Laptop (Ada) and AMD Radeon 740M (RADV).
